# effect-ui-extra v0.4.1

> Unified companion toolkit for @effect/ui: a11y (APG/RTL/names), page (zero-FOUC prefs/CSP/tabbable/Form validationMode/overlays/history/SSR), widgets (Command/Tree/AreaPicker/ScrollPicker/DateTimePicker/Carousel/ImageCropper/Timeline/Waterfall), direct-manipulation/NumberScale/VirtualGrid/CLDR date, OKLCH/WCAG/deltaEOK theme, spring/sheet/sectorOf motion, and 70-item shadcn-parity registry + CLI + MCP server

Install pinned to a commit SHA: `github:MaxFabian25/effect-ui-extra#<sha>`.
Import by subpath so bundlers tree-shake unused modules.

## Subpath Exports

### `effect-ui-extra/a11y`

15 WAI-ARIA APG pattern verifiers, LTR/RTL direction checks, accessible-name checks, and zero-DOM TestHost focus tracking.

- **Values (9):** `auditPattern`, `checkPattern`, `auditDirection`, `checkDirection`, `AccessibleNameError`, `auditAccessibleNames`, `checkAccessibleNames`, `NAMABLE_ROLES`, `PatternViolationError`
- **Types (14):** `DirectionAuditResult`, `AccessibleNameViolation`, `CheckAccessibleNamesOptions`, `A11yDriver`, `A11yTarget`, `AnyHtmlPlay`, `ApgPattern`, `CheckPatternOptions`, `Direction`, `DomTarget`, `KeyModifiers`, `NodeLike`, `Orientation`, `PatternViolation`

### `effect-ui-extra/page`

### `effect-ui-extra/direct`

Pure 2D spatial/grid focus, CellRange and lasso selection, SwipeActions, TestClock-driven holdEffect/repeatStream, cycle-safe TreeReorder, cross-container Kanban transfer, infinite canvas Viewport/Connect, quadratic edge AutoScroll, TimeSpan math, NumberScale (log/custom + locale parsing), draftMove controller, 2D VirtualGrid math, and CLDR firstDayOfWeek + PlainDate helpers.

### `effect-ui-extra/theme`

OKLCH/sRGB/Display-P3 color engine, hue-preserving gamut clamping, WCAG 2.1 and APCA contrast auditing, deltaEOK perceptual distance, 148 CSS named colors, theme CSS generation, and opt-in @layer effect-ui stylesheet (effect-ui-extra/theme/effect-ui.css).

- **Values (32):** `SCALE_STEPS`, `srgbToLinear`, `linearToSrgb`, `oklchToLinearSrgb`, `isInSrgbGamut`, `oklchToLinearP3`, `isInP3Gamut`, `clampToGamut`, `oklchToSrgb`, `srgbToOklch`, `parseColor`, `formatOklch`, `formatHex`, `mixOklch`, `generateScale`, `relativeLuminance`, `compositeOver`, `wcagContrast`, `meetsWcagAA`, `meetsWcagAAA`, `meetsUiControlContrast`, `apcaContrast`, `auditThemeContrast`, `TOKEN_CSS_NAMES`, `DEFAULT_LIGHT_TOKENS`, `DEFAULT_DARK_TOKENS`, `themeContrastPairs`, `generateThemeCss`, `CSS_NAMED_COLORS`, `deltaEOK`, `isPerceptuallyDistinct`, `resolveCssNamedColor`
- **Types (6):** `OklchColor`, `SrgbColor`, `ScaleStep`, `ContrastPair`, `ContrastFailure`, `ThemeTokens`

### `effect-ui-extra/motion`

Closed-form analytical springs, compositor CSS linear() easing, pointer velocity tracker, momentum projection, rubber-band overscroll, snap points, draggable sheet reducer, scroll-to-drag handoff, radial sectorOf math, Presence lifecycle, and Carousel reducer.

- **Values (24):** `settleTime`, `solveSpring`, `springLinearEasing`, `createVelocityTracker`, `findSnapIndex`, `nearestIndex`, `projectDistance`, `resolveSnapPoints`, `rubberBand`, `initialSheetState`, `reduceSheet`, `sheetBackdropProgress`, `initialPresenceState`, `reducePresence`, `carouselPageCount`, `initialCarouselState`, `isCarouselAutoplayActive`, `reduceCarousel`, `initialScrollHandoffState`, `isAtScrollBottom`, `isAtScrollTop`, `reduceScrollHandoff`, `sectorCenterAngleDeg`, `sectorOf`
- **Types (23):** `SpringConfig`, `SpringCssEasing`, `SpringSample`, `SnapPoint`, `VelocitySample`, `VelocityTracker`, `SheetConfig`, `SheetEvent`, `SheetPhase`, `SheetState`, `PresenceEvent`, `PresencePhase`, `PresenceState`, `CarouselConfig`, `CarouselEvent`, `CarouselState`, `ScrollBoundary`, `ScrollHandoffEdge`, `ScrollHandoffEvent`, `ScrollHandoffMode`, `ScrollHandoffState`, `ScrollHandoffTransition`, `SectorOptions`

### `effect-ui-extra/registry`

shadcn-style copy-paste styled component registry with 64/64 shadcn base/ui parity (70 total items including cn, dialog-card, data-table, and 3 page blocks), 5 WCAG-audited OKLCH visual presets, icon-pack switching (inline-svg, lucide, tabler), custom registry validate/build, JSON-RPC 2.0 effect-ui mcp server, and effect-ui CLI.

- **Values (38):** `decodeIconPack`, `decodePresetName`, `decodeProjectUiConfig`, `DEFAULT_UI_CONFIG`, `encodeProjectUiConfig`, `IconPackSchema`, `PresetNameSchema`, `ProjectUiConfigSchema`, `RegistryCategorySchema`, `RegistryFileSchema`, `RegistryItemSchema`, `generateIconModule`, `generatePresetCss`, `getVisualPreset`, `listVisualPresets`, `VISUAL_PRESETS`, `diffRegistryContent`, `getRegistryItem`, `listRegistryItems`, `REGISTRY_ITEMS`, `resolveRegistryTree`, `CONFIG_FILENAME`, `readProjectUiConfig`, `runAdd`, `runCli`, `runDiff`, `runIconPack`, `runInit`, `runPreset`, `writeProjectUiConfig`, `buildCustomRegistry`, `CustomRegistryManifestSchema`, `validateCustomRegistry`, `handleMcpLine`, `handleMcpRequest`, `MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION`, `MCP_TOOL_DEFINITIONS`, `runMcpServer`
- **Types (19):** `IconPack`, `PresetName`, `ProjectUiConfig`, `RegistryCategory`, `RegistryFile`, `RegistryItem`, `UiIconName`, `VisualPreset`, `FileDiffSummary`, `ResolvedRegistryPlan`, `AddResult`, `CliResult`, `InitResult`, `CustomRegistryManifest`, `RegistryBuildResult`, `RegistryValidationResult`, `JsonRpcRequest`, `JsonRpcResponse`, `McpToolDefinition`

### `effect-ui-extra/theme/effect-ui.css`

Optional `@layer effect-ui` default stylesheet with native `light-dark()` OKLCH tokens, `[data-color-scheme="light"|"dark"]` overrides for `effect-ui-extra/page`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `forced-colors`, and zero CSS `content:` icon hacks.

### `effect-ui-extra` (root namespace export)

Re-exports `A11y`, `Direct`, `Motion`, `Page`, `Registry`, `Theme`, and `Widgets` namespaces.
